integrity.computational_scope: Exhaustive checks for 2,131,004 nonempty subsets over four graph orders
integrity.nonmonotonic_minimality: Each proposed fort is tested against all fort subsets, not just one-vertex deletions.
integrity.proof_scope: Unrestricted in integer n>=3, with explicit classification of all inclusion-minimal forts

scientific_limitations: Applies to K_n subdivided exactly once, n>=3; does not classify all subdivision graphs.
Brute-force verification is complete only for n=3,4,5,6; the general theorem uses a written proof.
Publication priority remains provisional despite targeted searches and inspection of relevant source material.
title: Minimal forts of the once-subdivided complete graph: cycles, exceptional stars, and gaps
